name: nankai-business-review
description: Use when targeting 《南开管理评论》(Nankai Business Review) — a top Chinese business-school journal for strategy, organizational behavior, HRM, marketing, and corporate governance. Apply when a paper builds management theory grounded in the China context, uses survey/SEM or multi-case methods, and needs theoretical contribution framed for an OB/strategy audience rather than econometric policy evaluation.
